name: Dogeminer: CE
summary: Dogeminer: Community Edition is a DogeCoin Space Empire Mining Simulator Incremental Clicker game built and fueled by the community. It's intended to be an expansion upon the original games (Dogeminer 1 & 2), with a mix of old and new features, and suggestions from the community. The game is entirely open source, with all code for the game available on GitHub for modding, projects, or really anything (the code is free to use under the Apache license! The assets have a separate license however, so be sure to read that!)
